title: Interactive Clinical Data Explorer
text:
Below is an interactive clinical data explorer running directly in your browser via WebAssembly (Shinylive):
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 650
#| viewerWidth: 100%

library(shiny)

# 1. UI Definition
ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch = "flatly"),
  titlePanel("CDISC ADSL Variable Explorer"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("variable", "Select Demographic Metric:", 
                  choices = c("Age" = "AGE", "Baseline Height (cm)" = "HEIGHT", "Baseline Weight (kg)" = "WEIGHT")),
      sliderInput("bins", "Histogram Bins:", min = 5, max = 25, value = 12),
      checkboxInput("show_table", "Show Raw Data Table", value = TRUE)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("distPlot"),
      hr(),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.show_table == true",
        tableOutput("dataTable")
      )
    )
  )
)

# 2. Server Definition
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Synthetic ADSL Patient Data
  set.seed(42)
  adsl <- data.frame(
    USUBJID = paste0("PAT-", 101:120),
    AGE = round(rnorm(20, mean = 58, sd = 8)),
    HEIGHT = round(rnorm(20, mean = 168, sd = 10), 1),
    WEIGHT = round(rnorm(20, mean = 74, sd = 12), 1)
  )

  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    val <- adsl[[input$variable]]
    hist(val, breaks = input$bins, col = "#2c3e50", border = "white",
         xlab = input$variable, main = paste("Distribution of", input$variable))
  })

  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    head(adsl[, c("USUBJID", input$variable)], 8)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

title: Interactive ADSL Clinical Explorer
text:
Below is an interactive clinical data explorer fetching your pushed adsl.csv dataset directly from GitHub via WebAssembly (Shinylive):
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 700
#| viewerWidth: 100%

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

# 1. Fetch CSV directly from your public GitHub repository
csv_url <- "[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istaloni/ClinicalReportingBlog/main/posts/ADSL/adsl.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/istaloni/ClinicalReportingBlog/main/posts/ADSL/adsl.csv)"
adsl <- read.csv(url(csv_url), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. UI Definition
ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "ADSL Subject Level Explorer",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    selectInput("num_var", "Numeric Variable:", 
                choices = c("Age" = "AGE", "Baseline Height" = "HEIGHTBL", 
                            "Baseline Weight" = "WEIGHTBL", "Baseline BMI" = "BMIBL")),
    selectInput("cat_var", "Grouping Variable:", 
                choices = c("Treatment Arm" = "ARM", "Sex" = "SEX", 
                            "Race" = "RACE", "Site" = "SITEID")),
    sliderInput("bins", "Histogram Bins:", min = 5, max = 30, value = 15)
  ),
  card(
    card_header("Metric Distribution"),
    plotOutput("distPlot")
  ),
  card(
    card_header("Dataset Preview"),
    tableOutput("dataTable")
  )
)

# 3. Server Definition
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    req(input$num_var)
    val <- as.numeric(adsl[[input$num_var]])
    
    hist(val, breaks = input$bins, col = "#2c3e50", border = "white",
         xlab = input$num_var, 
         main = paste("Distribution of", input$num_var, "by", input$cat_var))
  })

  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    cols <- intersect(c("USUBJID", input$cat_var, input$num_var, "SAFFL", "DTHFL"), names(adsl))
    head(adsl[, cols], 10)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
